notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Pinnacle Monk
When Donnie & April and Pinnacle Monk enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
